assets.hero: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: wide website hero background, landscape 3:2. Create a refined editorial photograph evoking the life of a writer in Kerala, India: a timeworn dark teak writing desk beside a traditional wooden window opening onto softly blurred lush monsoon greenery. On the RIGHT half of the desk: an open cream notebook with subtle handwritten Malayalam-like writing too small to read, a fountain pen laid across it, a small stack of well-loved literary paperbacks, a simple ceramic cup. No person, no computer. Warm diffused daylight, quiet literary atmosphere, natural tactile paper and wood, warm brown and muted green. Composition critical: left 55 percent is calm darker negative space from the dim interior and plain desk for white headline overlay, writing objects grouped center-right, keep objects away from bottom-right corner. Camera horizontal at desk level, beautiful realistic photography, not illustration. No overlaid text, no logos, no watermark. This is an illustrative demo, not a real founder's room.
assets.media: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: landscape 3:2 website card for an advertising portfolio. Create a sophisticated photorealistic flat lay of finished colorful ADVERTISING CREATIVES, not an office or design tools: three overlapping printed poster campaigns and a smartphone showing a matching vertical video advertisement with a small play symbol. Fictional local Kerala cultural arts and cafe promotional campaigns, strong editorial typography, vibrant burnt orange, cream and dark forest green, striking block layouts, small abstract botanical and coffee product photos. Only large readable text on posters: 'MAKE AN IMPRESSION', 'FRESH IDEAS', 'LOCAL STORIES'. Supporting text can be sparse decorative lines, no brands or fake company logo. Posters arranged carefully across warm pale stone tabletop, soft directional daylight and subtle paper shadows. Tight crop so actual ad designs fill most of the image, coherent premium graphic design, no people, no laptop, no keyboard, no watermark. Keep outer top 15 percent free of essential text as website tag overlays it. This is sample creative artwork.
assets.books: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: landscape 3:2 website card for a Kerala literary book catalog. Editorial close-up photograph of a curated small collection of literary novels, poetry and short-story paperbacks on a dark teak reading table. Two upright books with tasteful illustrated covers and three books resting horizontally, one partly open with cream pages; tactile matte paper covers in terracotta, muted indigo, sage and cream, delicate Kerala landscape and botanical cover art. Covers evoke Malayalam literature from Kerala rather than western startup/business/self-help books. Any cover lettering should be tiny and out of focus, no prominent readable titles, no actual author attribution, no famous cover reproduction. Books are the clear primary subject filling the frame, softly blurred wooden bookshelf behind, warm Kerala afternoon window light, intimate thoughtful literary atmosphere, realistic photography with clear paper edges and textures. No computer, no people, no English business titles, no overlaid text, no logos, no watermark.
